method: Recorded decision graph reconstruction: parse stored roots and force/history verdicts; recompute frozen geometric enumeration/ranking metadata only; no source dynamics or trajectory reintegration.
identity_limit: Available-state keys include physical root excluding overwritten steer target, launch/tracking counts, progress and raw. Tracker and visited set are not in every journal event; do not claim full checkpoint/future equivalence.

ranking_evidence.interpretation: Slow physically different safe states were removed. Better future corner/time outcomes of those discarded states were not observed; yaw/clipping headroom is a descriptor, not verified future usefulness.

launch_summary.interpretation: Current launch already540-derived and near clipping budget, not an untouched fixed-gas baseline. No remaining lap-time gain inferred.

failure_mechanism.interpretation: All39loggedchildren of three fast parents fail raw2. Lateral component is arithmetic on their already recorded states; no new force_rows/wheel_response call. Does not prove unseen steering actions fail or alignment succeeds.

selected_next_intervention.changed_assumption: Pursuit target required for short-horizon steering; replace it by full-state wheel-slip alignment feedback only for two holds.
selected_next_intervention.method_family: Mechanical slip-regulating steering feedback, not a larger pursuit beam or a velocity-frame pursuit.
selected_next_intervention.selection_rule: Largest progress among the three first hold32competitiveparents whose13children allfailedraw2; tie lower instance. Fixed using stored579only.
selected_next_intervention.hypothesis_limits: No next trajectory simulated. Common two-wheel heading target is not exact simultaneous alignment or guaranteed force reduction; servo/joint/yaw reaction and corridor may invalidate it.
